objective: Implement ticket 938a7ae9: Track query and rollup surface — add track query and rollup functions to session-api that report session count, status distribution, aggregate tool/cost metrics, duration, per-agent breakdown.
decisions: Track storage is schema-only: no track entity, no track store, no track status field.
Migration is fail-open: track_id nullable, pre-existing sessions have no track, no backfill pass.
Session artifacts under .session/sessions/<workspace_session_id>/; machine-local state under .session/local/; legacy .session/runtime/workspaces/<id>/ removed.
Merge semantics: prefer incoming non-None, preserve existing non-None when incoming is None.
non_goals: No track entity, no new store, no track status field.
No parallel sessions within a track (deferred to ticket 25dd26cb).
No response post-processing to force session ids.
No reimplementation of the existing iteration loop or handoff package schema.
